en.titulo: DeepSeek prices search and fetch at $0.75 per 1000 successful requests
en.resumo: According to the DeepSeek API docs, the search and fetch tools cost $0.75 per 1000 successful requests. The Search API finds web pages for a query, and the Fetch API returns the content of a single page as Markdown.

fontes.titulo: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins

pt.titulo: Claude descobre a origem das sementes de curvas NIST usadas no ECDSA
pt.resumo: Segundo a Anthropic, o Claude descobriu em menos de meia hora a origem das sementes das curvas NIST P-192, P-224, P-256, P-384 e P-521. Elas não vieram de um algoritmo de hash, e sim do gerador lrand48, inicializado com um carimbo de tempo Unix. A empresa afirma que não há quebra criptográfica nem fraqueza nas curvas.

en.titulo: Claude uncovers the origin of NIST curve seeds used in ECDSA
en.resumo: According to Anthropic, Claude discovered in under half an hour where the seeds of the NIST P-192, P-224, P-256, P-384 and P-521 curves came from. They were not hash outputs but came from the lrand48 generator seeded with a Unix timestamp. The company says this is not a cryptographic break or a weakness in the curves.
